messages:
Zoe Park: quick thread on the invite UX + audit links. spotted two usability gaps: users keep sending invites that fail due to SSO and then open Audit Log to debug. proposal: inline compatibility check + one-click audit deep-link that preserves filters and highlights the related events. thoughts?
Marcus Liu: inline check is great. suggest showing domain status (OK / SSO enforced / unknown) to the right of the email input. small spinner while checking. keep it non-blocking so power users can bypass.
Dana White: accessibility notes: announce status changes with aria-live=polite and ensure the check is reachable via keyboard. if we show a 'why blocked' control, it should open a dialog with role="dialog" and focus the heading.
Priya Desai: microcopy: for the deep-link CTA use 'Open audit (filtered)' not just 'View logs'. and when we open a new tab, include a short toast saying 'Audit opened in new tab' for keyboard users. also standardize on 'Enforce SSO' for toggles across the org settings.
Zoe Park: regarding highlight in audit: anchor the event and show a small context window (3 events above & below). URL should encode filters but not raw emails unless user explicitly opts-in to include PII. use a shared token for saved filters.
Marcus Liu: implementation note: saved-filter tokens map to DB id; deep-link can include token + anchor id. fallback: if anchor not found (event aged out), open with closest timestamp and show a warning.
Dana White: bulk-invite undo: after sending a batch show toast 'Invites sent — Undo (30s)'. make toast focusable and SR announce "Undo available". pressing Undo should call an API to revert and then announce result.
Priya Desai: keyboard discovery: include g then i to open invite modal (consistent with other quick nav). document shortcut in the shortcuts modal and keep shortcuts opt-in in user prefs.
Zoe Park: action items: Marcus -> API & token plan; Dana -> a11y copy + dialog behaviors; Priya -> finalize microcopy and CTA wording; I'll update Figma with inline status chip and audit deep-link flow. target: preliminary mocks by Tue.
AuditBot: reminder: run contrast checks for status chips and file accessibility ticket if needed.
